answer: Quarantine newcomers on an island: a fresh identity can only trade with other newcomers and a few vetted sponsors. To leave it must earn a lantern, a tamper-evident record of useful work across several epochs, co-signed by independent peers who already carry theirs. Each sponsor stands on a ledge of staked reputation: if its protege is exposed as a sybil, the sponsor's lantern dims and its stake is slashed. A farmer must keep a thousand islands of fake activity alive for epochs, each needing real work and sponsors risking real standing, so a fake crowd costs nearly as much as a real one.
